sources.title: Fix DeepSeek-V4-Flash Official FP8 Running Across 2x DGX Spark TP2 MTP ...
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Flash is a massive MoE model — roughly 149GB across 46 shards in native FP8 (E4M3 128×128 block format). Running it on a single DGX Spark (GB10, 128GB unified memory) simply isn't possible. You need two nodes with TP=2, and you need the right vLLM fork with GB10-specific validation baked in.
